provenance.transformation: Split every numeric V30 atom and bond row after its id using a V3000 continuation. Keep all 64 records, names, atoms, bonds and coordinates.
provenance.normalization: UTF-8; LF line endings; numeric text and all 64 record positions unchanged

redistribution.rationale: Physical-line re-framing of original synthetic project input; project dual license applies.

minimization: All 64 predetermined 16..1024-atom chains are retained to cover vector-growth thresholds and continuation fallback scaling without post-measurement selection. Smaller synthetic molecules and malformed lines are separate differential unit tests. No rich chemistry or new third-party data is added.

oracle.source_engines: Both source-version 1.1.4 native executables pinned by source-manifest.json
oracle.settings: Native snapshot and dump, repeats=1, expected_records=64; original and continued outputs byte-identical across both arms. Original graphs/coordinates also have the pinned RDKit observer gate.
oracle.observer_settings: Existing native V3000 benchmark observer; original fixed chain input, no marker changes or filtering.

expected.status: Byte-identical original and continued indexed graphs, exact coordinate bits, metadata, diagnostic snapshots and rewrites in both source arms.
expected.interpretation: Source-only continuation regression diagnostic; never an Open Babel ranking.
